> Merge several SDRF documents into one analysis table, stamping each row with the document it came from.

Wire verb `sdrf pool` · Python [`pymzlib.sdrf.pool`][pymzlib.sdrf.pool]

### Wraps

- [`SdrfCollection.Merge`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfCollection.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfCollection.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`SdrfDocument.WriteResults`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfDocument.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfDocument.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stdin` | `string[]` | required | — | `>= 1 line` | One document per line: path, optionally a TAB and a provenance label. Label every line or none; a partial set is a usage error. Blank lines are ignored. |
| `out` | `path` | absent | — | — | Write the WHOLE merged document here as SDRF, whatever offset and limit are. The write is atomic since mzLib 1.0.592 (#1324): a temp file moved into place. |
| `offset` | `int` | `0` | rows | `>= 0` | Skip this many merged rows in the payload. |
| `limit` | `int` | absent | rows | `>= 0` | Return at most this many merged rows. Absent means every row. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `document_count` | `int` | documents | never | Documents pooled. |
| `paths` | `string[]` | — | never | The paths, in stdin order. |
| `labels` | `string[]` | — | never | The label stamped for each document: the one supplied, or mzLib's containing-folder/file-stem default. |
| `column_names` | `string[]` | — | never | The union header in SDRF block order; a repeated name at the highest multiplicity any one document used; comment[source document] added. |
| `row_count` | `int` | rows | never | Merged rows before the window. |
| `returned_count` | `int` | rows | never | Rows in rows. |
| `offset` | `int` | rows | never | The offset applied. |
| `truncated` | `bool` | — | never | True whenever rows were left out. |
| `rows` | `string[][]` | — | never | Row-major raw cells, as for sdrf read. |
| `written` | `object` | — | yes: out was not given | {path, row_count}; row_count is the whole merged document. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Four static caveats, plus a fifth when no labels were supplied. |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | stdin empty; a blank path; a file not found; some lines labelled and some not |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | offset or limit negative or not an integer |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | mzLib cannot read one of the documents |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | never raised by this verb |

### Caveats

- An ANALYSIS table, not a deposit: source name + assay name + comment[label] is unique per document, not across documents. Key on comment[source document] too.
- Without labels, provenance depends on where the files sit, so the table is not reproducible on another machine.

### Example

```python
pooled = pymzlib.sdrf.pool({'PXD000070.sdrf.tsv': 'malaria', 'PXD026824.sdrf.tsv': 'colon'}, limit=4)
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`sdrf_pool_two.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/sdrf_pool_two.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.
